claims.claim: The walk from Rockridge to the hospital is a straight shot down College Avenue, past the shops and the families out on the sidewalks, then over toward Broadway. It's a route I know well, but I wasn't walking it before I was admitted. The days before, I was working through another weekend, telling myself it was fine. My wife held down the house, the kids, the meals, the school runs — she always does. At work, my team covered my accounts, my clients, the paperwork. I didn't have a shift to hand off; I just had to trust people. And I did. But I'll tell you, when you're in that bed, you think about the people who carried you there — and the ones who carried you before you even fell.
